responsibility: Generic native validation adapter, outside Define and domain planning.
authorization: Complete the authorized migration and its verification without repeated validation of identical schema metadata.
chain: Definitions: existing exact artifact binding and schema validation obligations
Artifacts: JSON schema documents remain byte/content-bound before use
Ontology: cache identity is the complete canonical schema value, never a path, version label or record
Business-system bridge: reuse successful metadata checks only for an exact unchanged schema and the same default checking options
System ontology: bounded process-local cache of successful check_schema results
AlchLang: all existing admission and construction decision kernels remain unchanged
Generation: select and qualify the changed generic adapter closure; original authored model and native source profile unchanged
invariants: All signatures, transaction replay and source-freshness checks still execute.
Only successful metadata checks may be cached; invalid schemas never enter cache.
Changed schema content produces a miss.
The cache is process-local, bounded to 128 entries and never persisted or trusted from disk.
